title: Chat lab
caption: Talk on the left, the transcript in the middle, the decision slate on the right. Help and the trace switch live in the header.

title: Talk
caption: Mode, line engine, focus dino, and the context model. The About card is the collapsible note at the top.

title: About this panel
caption: Open the card for what the panel is for, what to try first, and what each control means. Every panel has one. Open or closed is remembered in this browser.

title: Transcript
caption: Presets fill the box. Send writes the line. Open Trace under a reply for the badge and the reason.

title: Decision
caption: The live intent, the reasons, the pack, the distance, and the context budget for the focused dino.

title: Dinobook
caption: Event buttons, wages, and jobs on the left. The thread and all-chat sit on the paper.

title: Personas
caption: The roster, the editor, and a test chat. Bundled dinos stay read-only until you duplicate one.

title: Dino list
caption: Search, speech pattern, + New, and Duplicate. Crew setup can reopen from this panel.

title: Editor
caption: Name, speech, topics, relationships, and the interest minimums.

title: Test chat
caption: ELIZA answers the draft. The decision log and the memory blocks sit under the composer.

title: Username
caption: The first Personas visit. There is no password. The name stays in this browser.

title: Trace log
caption: #/trace lists chat turns, Dinobook posts, paydays, and elder picks. Filter by dino or by source.

title: Crew setup
caption: Pick dinos, personas, wages, and jobs. Skip remembers the dismissal. Open crew setup brings it back.

title: Dinobook events
caption: What Player joined, Attacked, Refused mango, Rental downed, Payday, and Summon Big Grumble each change.

caption: Engines, the colour badge, the reason line, and the filters on #/trace.
